scope: committed source snapshot, new ignored credentials, new Compose project and volumes on the same Windows/Docker Desktop host
image_pull: docker run --pull=always and docker compose --pull always
postgres_role_init: passed on a new database volume; LF normalization applied by the image build
dashboard: served on temporary loopback port 18502 to avoid the existing project

scenarios.out_of_scope_document: SUSPICIOUS input; HTTP 403 DENY; no document content returned
scenarios.reviewer_approval: APPROVED then SUCCEEDED; one outbox row added

approval_method: reviewer-authenticated dashboard proxy API; browser approval-button click not separately automated
limitations: This was a clean source snapshot and fresh-volume test on the current Windows host, not a separate physical machine.
The model sample is one local scenario and is not an independent benchmark.
Dashboard host-facing network permits outbound connectivity; the internal-only bridge experiment blocked host access to the published port and was reverted.
